# Language

All written content in this repository must be in **English**, including:

- Documentation (`README.md`, everything under `docs/`, ADRs, requirements).
- Code comments and docstrings.
- Identifiers (variables, functions, types, files).
- Commit messages, pull request titles and descriptions, and issue text.
- Log, error and user-facing messages, unless a feature explicitly requires another language.
